nodes.label: fix_requests_rls migration — privacy fix: SELECT on requests restricted to owner + authenticated pros (open requests only), previously any anon key could read all requests with address
nodes.norm_label: fix_requests_rls migration — privacy fix: select on requests restricted to owner + authenticated pros (open requests only), previously any anon key could read all requests with address

nodes.label: dedupe_rls_policies migration — removes duplicate EN/ES RLS policies on profiles/professionals/quotes, unifies on (select auth.uid()), restricts professionals reads to authenticated users
nodes.norm_label: dedupe_rls_policies migration — removes duplicate en/es rls policies on profiles/professionals/quotes, unifies on (select auth.uid()), restricts professionals reads to authenticated users

nodes.label: protect_columns migration — triggers block pro self-verification (verified/rating/jobs_completed) and client tampering with quote amount; unique index enforces one accepted quote per request
nodes.norm_label: protect_columns migration — triggers block pro self-verification (verified/rating/jobs_completed) and client tampering with quote amount; unique index enforces one accepted quote per request

nodes.label: quote_flow migration — trigger moves request pending→quoted on quote insert (RLS was silently blocking it before); adds atomic accept_quote() RPC; backfills inconsistent requests
nodes.norm_label: quote_flow migration — trigger moves request pending→quoted on quote insert (rls was silently blocking it before); adds atomic accept_quote() rpc; backfills inconsistent requests

nodes.label: ticket_and_new_user migration — ticket_id now assigned uniquely server-side (was a random 4-digit client-side value causing collisions); handle_new_user trigger creates profile row on signup, avoiding orphan users
nodes.norm_label: ticket_and_new_user migration — ticket_id now assigned uniquely server-side (was a random 4-digit client-side value causing collisions); handle_new_user trigger creates profile row on signup, avoiding orphan users

nodes.label: perf_and_updated_at migration — indexes for uncovered FKs, automatic updated_at maintenance
nodes.norm_label: perf_and_updated_at migration — indexes for uncovered fks, automatic updated_at maintenance

nodes.label: harden_functions_and_merge_policy migration — revokes EXECUTE on trigger functions (should not be callable as RPC), unifies requests SELECT policies
nodes.norm_label: harden_functions_and_merge_policy migration — revokes execute on trigger functions (should not be callable as rpc), unifies requests select policies
